owner_name.doc: The owner's name: handbooks say "the owner", and one line names them.

owner_email.doc: The owner's board account (the only one setup creates, ops/setup.sh).

timezone.doc: The instance's timezone (schedules and the owner's day).

company_name.doc: The Paperclip company this instance runs.

instance_name.doc: Short name of this AidenHQ; the agents org (where an approved create_repo card creates repos) is aidenhq-<instance_name> unless github_agents_org names another.

autonomy.doc: Tiered approvals: "off" = every write is the owner's card, the AI reviewer reading Tier 1 first (its reject is final; also the pause switch); "tier0" = Tier 0 runs at once and the AI reviewer only comments on Tier 1; "full" = the reviewer decides Tier 1. Full only after reviewer-eval scores 100%.

backup_repository.doc: Off-host backup (ops/backup-offsite.sh): a restic repository, e.g. sftp://u12345@u12345.your-storagebox.de:23/aidenhq. Set, apply installs a nightly timer (03:00 UTC); its password is the vault's restic_password. Unset = no off-host backup.

exposure.doc: How the board is reached, and so what the host firewall opens on the public interface (ops/vm/public-fw.sh): public = HTTPS on 443 (tcp 22, 443); tailscale = the tailnet (tcp 22, udp 41641); cloudflare = a Cloudflare tunnel, local = loopback through an SSH tunnel (tcp 22 only). Unset = tailscale; ops/setup.sh writes it. A change reaches the firewall when ops/vm/setup.sh runs again (root).
